phrases.latin: Carrulum Theodōrus trūdere voluit; sed cum carrulus ipsō major esset, in eō sēdit, patre impellente.
phrases.english: Theo wanted to push the trolley; but as it was bigger than he was, he sat in it while Dad pushed.

sources: Lewis & Short: carrulus · Lewis & Short: trudo
